posts.name: The Washington Post
posts.text:
Former vice president Al Gore is purchasing a local newspaper in Carthage, Tennessee, his hometown.

The Carthage Courier said that Gore will assume ownership after the family that has owned the paper for half a century listed it for sale this fall.
